title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (June, 2025)
summary: June 2025 cumulative updates released for Business Central across multiple versions (BC26 CU02, BC25 CU08, BC24 CU14). Includes platform and application build numbers for both cloud SaaS and on-premises deployments, plus lifecycle information showing support dates for versions from 2019 through 2025 release waves.
key_points: BC26 CU02 (26.2) cloud build is Platform 26.0.34852.0 with Application 26.2.34746.34995; on-premises uses Platform 26.0.34736.0 with Application 26.2.34746.34832
BC25 CU08 (25.8) ships application build 25.8.34727 on platform 25.2.34690; BC24 CU14 (24.14) ships application 24.14.34725 on platform 24.0.34688
BC23 back to BC15, plus BC13, are listed as end of life; BC14 is at end of mainstream support
Under the Modern Lifecycle Policy, 26.x is supported until Oct 13, 2026, 25.x until Apr 4, 2026 and 24.x until Oct 7, 2025
Under the Fixed Lifecycle Policy, version 14.x extended support ends Oct 14, 2025

quotes.text: Dynamics 365 Business Central on-premises (Modern Policy) follows the Modern Lifecycle Policy.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the support model for modern versions, important for planning upgrade timelines
